protocol.description: Experimental compositor-specific protocol. A new scope protects every seat and output by default. Before activate, a trusted management client may allow preauthorized secondary seats and exclude managed private headless outputs. Seat identity and control generation are checked on activation and on input. Unknown seats and newly connected outputs remain protected. Secure follows presentation of protected lock frames or confirmation that outputs are off. This is not a full ext-session-lock. Scope owner or guard loss escalates to an orphaned full lock and never unlocks. Ordinary ext-session-lock is unchanged.

interface.name: hyprland_lock_guard_v1
interface.description: Loss of this guard during a scoped lock atomically escalates to an orphaned full lock and revokes exemptions. It never unlocks.
